# Om Shakti Catering Services

> Authentic South Indian & multi-cuisine catering across Tamil Nadu (based in Chennai) for weddings, receptions, corporate events, house functions and festivals. Serving since 2007.

## Key facts
- Business: Om Shakti Catering Services (brand mark: "KS Om Shakti Catering Services")
- Founded: 2007
- Based in: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
- Serves: Chennai, Coimbatore, Madurai, Tiruchirappalli, Salem, Erode, Tirupur, Vellore and across Tamil Nadu
- Cuisines: South Indian, North Indian, Chettinad, multi-cuisine
- Services: Wedding catering, reception catering, corporate event catering, house function & festival catering, live counters
